sentences.en: He already tried five different hair-growing supplements to no avail.
sentences.zh: 他已經嘗試了五種不同的頭髮生長補品都無濟於事。

sentences.en: What sort of independent study should I do to supplement classes?
sentences.zh: 为了补充课堂学习，我应该做一些什么样的独立研究？

sentences.en: You had better supplement your diet with vitamins.
sentences.zh: 你最好通過補充維生素來改善你的飲食結構。
